t: H2O: Just Add Water: Just a Girl at Heart
d: Bella helps Will with his free-diving training but when she realises he's more interested in her as a mermaid than a girl, she's hurt. Rikki and Cleo have to improvise when the cafe's first corporate function is actually a children's party.

t: H2O: Just Add Water: Crime and Punishment
d: Rikki receives counterfeit money at the café and is held captive by criminals on a boat. Bella and Cleo are forced to reveal the trio's secret to Will, so they can rescue Rikki together.

t: H2O: Just Add Water: To Have and to Hold Back
st: To Have and to Hold Back
d: Kim attempts to derail Don and Samantha's wedding. Lewis receives an opportunity to study in America. Cleo realises she's got to let Lewis live his own life and let him go overseas.
A rematch between Gingka and Kyoya ends in a tie.

st: The Third Match, on the Edge
d: Tsubasa defeats Benkei and Damoure, but has to channel dark forces to do so.

st: The End of a Fierce Struggle!
d: Gingka and Masamune lead Gangan Galaxy to victory over Wild Fang.
Team Excalibur defeats Team Wang Hu Zhong.
Klaus defeats Chiyun and eliminates Wang Hu Zhong.
Julian Konzern battles Tsubasa and Ryuga.
Sabrina is just sick of the winter weather. She, Chloe, and Salem would give anything for one hour at the beach.
Sabrina has a crush on Dave, her new piano instructor.
Sabrina uses her magic to conjure up an advance copy of the latest Spy flick to make Harvey happy.
Hilda’s is not pleased when her old vampire buddies, The Bat Pack, swoop into town for a visit.

Sabrina is having a tough week. Cassandra, Margaux, and Tiffany are being a pain at school. Her aunts blame her for a mess Salem made in her room. Even reliable Harvey seems to be ignoring her (a misunderstanding).

t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: The Incredible Shrinking Teens
d: Archie and Jughead accidentally shrink themselves in a shrink machine at a local Mad Scientist convention.

t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: Little Chock'lit Shoppe Of Horrors
d: In an attempt to make Pop's Chock'lit Shoppe more efficient, Dilton installs some high-tech labor-saving devices which ultimately conflict with Pop's personal attention policy.
An alien invasion turns Riverdale teenagers into zoned out couch potatoes, while sentient space potatoes mutate to replace them as vegetable zombies.

Rikki sets Cleo up at a karaoke contest as a joke, where she is humiliated due to her lack of talent. However, her singing ability undergoes a dramatic change when, in spite of the girls' precautions, she is hypnotized by the full moon.
When the mysterious, old Miss Chatham's boat and home is declared unseaworthy, Emma invites her over to stay. Zane gets trapped on the sinking boat and Emma tries to save him but he sees a tail.

Cleo's 16th birthday is approaching and she thinks that her father is going to throw another embarrasing birthday party. Meanwhile, Zane tries to find the 'sea monster' that he saw when he almost drowned.

Emma is put in charge of managing the juice bar. Miriam decides to cause trouble and cuts the power to the cool room, then is unwittingly frozen by Emma who uses her powers to fix the freezer. Will the girls be able to thaw Miriam out?
A dolphin at Sea World will only eat from Cleo’s hand and when she has to sneak out to feed him, everyone thinks she has a boyfriend.

st: ATM with the Heart of Gold
d: Trouble ensues when Eerie's first automatic teller machine becomes obsessed with Simon.
In order to save his parents' marriage, Marshall must locate his dad's lost briefcase. During the search, Marhsall and Simon encounter yet another strange happening in Eerie.

Wendell the nerd never wanted any trouble.  In fact, he did everything he could to fit in and earn the respect of tough jock Rex Reavis and his friends, including dismissing all their cruel practical jokes with a shrug and a laugh.
Best friends Camille and Mildred are obsessed with monsters and vampires.
Lowly Walter would like nothing more than to join Ken "kingpin" Seldon's secret club.
Gus has an incredible string of good luck culminating in his becoming the captain of the school's Soomer-crosse team. When Cassy becomes jealous of her pal's success.
When Gus and Cassy accidentally sit in Siege Perilous, the legendary throne of Galahad created by Merlin, they begin to return to their magical “roots.”

Scott and his family volunteer on a farm for a week, but it proves to be a lot more work than they've expected. The animals sense that the Howards are werewolves and flee, leaving the Howards responsible for finding them before the farmer's return.

The town statue is stolen by a couple of crooks who ask for ransom money. The Howards learn that the inside of the statue contains the diary of their distant werewolf relative, and grow concerned that the diary could get into the wrong hands.

Scott's werewolf family comes to town for a family reunion. Scott's cousin, Eva, goes on a date with Mick, and it's Scott's responsibility to protect the family secret before it's revealed that Eva is a werewolf.
Pam's sheepdog, Daisy, gets loose and chases Ballard the cat.  When Mr. Conroy is called to catch Daisy, he bumps into Grandpa, switches glasses with him, and takes him to the pound instead of Daisy.
A film about a mean and violent werewolf is shot in Wolverton. Outraged by the poor misrepresentation of werewolves, Scott decides to be a stuntman in order to change the horror film into a comedy.
Archie is temporarily unable to type, so Reggie offers to write the Weird Mystery article for the school paper.
